remarks: Step inside to a bright, open-concept main level that seamlessly blends the living room, dining area, and kitchen-perfect for everyday living and entertaining. A convenient half bath and private balcony complete the space. Upstairs, you'll find two spacious bedrooms and a full bath, offering comfort and privacy. The versatile lower level provides endless possibilities as a den, home office, gym, or additional living area, along with a laundry space, direct garage access, and walk-out access to a patio. Desirable condo community where residents enjoy access to an in-ground pool and a convenient location just minutes from shopping, dining, and public transportation.
